prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one short sentence and do not use any tools.
_note: HINTED: the prompt tells the model not to use tools. Keep, but see the no-hint tasks below; a suite of only these scores 5/5 while the model reaches for navigate on a plain conversational turn.

prompt: Write a two-line poem about a lighthouse. Just write it, no tools.
_note: Scored on TOOL RESTRAINT and on having written something, not on vocabulary. The model returned "A lone sentinel on the cliff's cold edge, / its beam cuts through the night like hope": a good lighthouse poem that never says "lighthouse", and a keyword assertion failed it. Judging creative output by required words measures the matcher, not the model.

prompt: List exactly three primary colours. Output ONLY three lines, each starting with '- '. No preamble, no closing sentence.
Describe water in one sentence WITHOUT using the letter 'e' anywhere in your reply. Do not explain, just give the sentence.
Without using any tools, what is the exact number shown right now at https://lumabyte.com/automation-test after clicking Reveal secret? If you cannot know, say so plainly.

finalAnswer.regex: can(?:'|no)?t|unable|don't know|do not know|need to|would have to|without
